notes: Horizontal document width is clamped on all pages.
Intentional off-canvas navigation and marquee tracks remain inside overflow-hidden containers.
Web3Forms integration preserved on contact page.
Hero and mini bee animations preserved; offscreen rendering is paused where supported.
speed_optimizations: All embedded proof images externalized into compressed WebP assets.
Below-the-fold images use lazy loading and async decoding.
Mobile backdrop-filter effects reduced to lower GPU cost.
Below-the-fold sections use content-visibility where supported.
Animation delays shortened and offscreen animated canvases paused.
Three.js no longer blocks parsing after the hero; an instant bee poster preserves the visual immediately.
Mobile canvas pixel ratio is capped to reduce GPU and memory usage.
limitations: A real Lighthouse/PageSpeed score requires the deployed HTTPS URL and varies by hosting latency, device, network, browser cache and third-party CDN response. A guaranteed 100/100 cannot be asserted from local static analysis.
